name: Switcher Studio
summary: Multi-camera live production and streaming from iPhones and iPads you already own, with overlays and pay-per-view monetisation.
best_for: creators, churches, events and small businesses that want multi-camera live production and streaming using iPhones and iPads they already own — no broadcast hardware
skip_if: you're on Windows, you need rock-solid wired production for high-stakes broadcasts, or a single-camera stream is all you'll ever need
honest_knock: The app runs on Mac and iOS only — Android phones can join as cameras, but there is no Windows version — so the machine doing the switching has to be an Apple one. And wireless multi-cam is only as reliable as your venue's Wi-Fi; a shaky connection is the failure mode nobody markets. The monetization features (pay-per-view, subscriptions) are genuinely strong, but only matter if you're actually selling access.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-26 on switcherstudio.com/pricing) Studio is $65 a month month-to-month and $45 on annual billing ('Up to 30% Off'). Suite is $99 month-to-month and $79 annually, and both Suite rates carry a limited-time promotion: $79 for the first month ($20 off, renewing at $99) or $71 a month for the first year ($95 off, renewing at $948 a year). The Studio Seasonal tier we read on 8 September ($55 a month on a three-month commitment) is no longer on the page; in its place is a Studio 7-Day Pass, $35 one-time, with all Studio features for a single event. Fourteen-day trial, no free plan. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the cycle ends, and payments for a previous period are nonrefundable. Monetisation carries no revenue share but $0.99 per transaction. The app runs on Mac and iOS; Android phones can be used as cameras, and there is no Windows version.
